title: Flirt Frenzy by CrimsonLace Studios
author: SeniorSpecific1774
selftext:
Hello everyone.

In this game, you have one main quest: conquer the heart of your chosen bachelorette. To succeed, you’ll need to develop your core stats, because each girl reacts differently to your personality, charm, and decisions.

[https://crimsonlace.itch.io/flirt-frenzy](https://crimsonlace.itch.io/flirt-frenzy)

[https://crimsonlace.itch.io/](https://crimsonlace.itch.io/)

The game features 5 main girls. Each one has her own personality, desires, and preferences. Think you’ve got what it takes to win them all? Let’s see if you’re really that smooth.

This game was created as both a learning experience and a passion project, let me also tell you that, yes, i did used AI to create this game but i was mainly for generating the some images who were posteriorly edited by me using Krita, all the rest of the game was created by me using some default assets and free assets which were a bit retouched by me, still using Krita and Aseprite.

I invite you all to play it and leave a comment, this in this project, I ended up turning to AI to speed up some areas where I’m weaker, and mainly because I wanted to feel like I was actually finishing a project. So i would be quite honored :) if you could download my game and give me a follow, the game has a small donation but i would rather have you all play it for free.
